message:
We’ve all been there—you're in the middle of an important call when your phone suddenly dies, or you realize your tablet's battery is at 2% right when you need directions. It’s a reminder that while technology is a great aid, it can sometimes let us down at the worst moments. 

That’s why we keep backup chargers and printed maps in our go-bags. A little preparation can go a long way in keeping us connected and informed, even when our gadgets decide to take a nap. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying prepared when tech fails us?
